scope: Repository-wide terminology/path search across authored JSON, Markdown, scripts, generated HTML/navigation and phase contracts; semantic classification, not global keyword deletion

classifications.E: Ordinary asset import or feature development

findings.original_assumption: Migration from game_docs; replace local Profile/SaveGame/platformer implementations
findings.corrected_interpretation: Historical Documentation Reference and Design Differences; independent requirements and optional provenance; no old classes or saves are required

findings.original_assumption: Briarwake branding assumed Source/Briarwake physical naming
findings.corrected_interpretation: Retain original proposal as superseded history; ADR-011 verifies physical RPG identifiers without changing branding

findings.original_assumption: Future module Source/Briarwake/Briarwake.Build.cs and planned types in a module absent from current main
findings.corrected_interpretation: Stable Briarwake contract points to existing RPG.Build.cs; planned native types belong in Source/RPG; source-inspected is distinct from implemented

findings.original_assumption: Phase 00 creates/activates an already existing module
findings.corrected_interpretation: Separate verifies_existing from creates/activates, preserve dependency IDs/order, verify descriptor/module/targets/content/engine/plugins/toolchain without a replacement project

findings.original_assumption: BriarwakeServer/BriarwakeClient naming assumed for future processes
findings.corrected_interpretation: RPGServer/RPGClient explicitly proposed additive Phase 04 targets; only RPG/RPGEditor observed; no new target is a Phase 00 prerequisite

findings.source: Getting started, all phase class-creation paragraphs and native asset instructions
findings.original_assumption: Future game repository/blank native-type preparation blurred existing workspace and planned features
findings.corrected_interpretation: Use existing checkout and RPG module; retain configured ARPGGameMode/URPGGameInstance and assets; follow user-led class creation without duplicate owners or automatic renames

findings.original_assumption: Keep proposed Source/Briarwake destination and wait for rename reconciliation
findings.corrected_interpretation: Supersede instructional resolution with ADR-011; retain earlier resolution, revisions and PR claims as historical evidence

findings.source: EEquipmentSlot description and items appearance recipe
findings.original_assumption: Map legacy labels suggested converting an old enum as a development input
findings.corrected_interpretation: Independent fifteen stable logical slots; optional terminology comparison only; keep ordinal/version safety and visual fallback policy

findings.source: README/DELIVERY_STATUS and entry-page original access claims
findings.original_assumption: Historical absence/publication failures could be read as current missing project or required source migration
findings.corrected_interpretation: Label as historical, reference current pinned source evidence, preserve old verification records and master/source excerpts

findings.source: Phases 06/07/17/22/31; character/faction records; transfer and transaction contracts
findings.original_assumption: Migration/schema/legacy identifier terminology in within-Briarwake compatibility
findings.corrected_interpretation: Retained: character/vocation/faction schema upgrades, recovery, stable content aliases, existing North Road evolution, fenced zone ownership and deployment/restore safeguards

findings.source: Paper2D/PaperZD imports, art/plugin audit and ordinary new feature instructions
findings.original_assumption: Imports/adaptation refer to licensed materials or technical integration rather than an old source game
findings.corrected_interpretation: Retained source rights, archive audit, version verification and ordinary new art/feature creation gates

phase_audit.existing_prerequisite: Briarwake stable contract / physical RPG module, verified at 00
phase_audit.all_later_phases: Current module and user-led class creation guidance; existing feature fixtures/acceptance/scope preserved

publication_boundary: Only mmo_docs; historical https://evanmcpheron.github.io/game_docs/assets/Core/RPG.html is not changed or republished
